title: Breezy 1 Charters
specs: Fishing for all Lake Michigan salmon and trout species including King salmon, Coho salmon, Steelhead, Brown Trout, and Lake Trout
Boat equipped with modern fish-finding sonar, GPS mapping, and 70-mile weather radar
Spacious deck with over 200 square feet of fishing space
Air-conditioned cabin, private restroom with running water, kitchen/fridge area
Maximum 6 passengers per Coast Guard regulations
Children under 5 may not enjoy the trip; under 10 should be accompanied one-on-one by an adult
All persons 16 or older must have a fishing license and Lake Michigan salmon stamp
Fishing license can be purchased onboard or locally; check availability first
No illegal substances allowed; alcohol permitted if of legal age
No need to bring fishing equipment; all provided
